Should ballots be required, horses that have already contested a Heat of this series will be the first ballot. Winner of this race automatically gains a start in the $100,000 North Star Series Final held at Albion Park on December 5. For clarity, a Queensland trainer will include trainers who permanently reside and train in the Tweed Local Government Area and race the majority of their starters in Queensland. Should ballots be required, horses that have already contested a Heat of this series will be the first ballot. Winner of this race automatically gains a start in the $100,000 North Star Series Final held at Albion Park on December 5. A 1% deduction for Equine Welfare will be applied to all prizemoney prior to distribution.
RaceClass: 3YO and older. NR up to 75. PBD/NR. Pacers
